########################################################################
# Include python install macros
########################################################################
include(GrPython)
if(NOT PYTHONINTERP_FOUND)
    return()
endif()

add_subdirectory(bindings)

########################################################################
# Install python sources
########################################################################
gr_python_install(FILES __init__.py control.py host_port.py modules.py jscc.py DESTINATION ${GR_PYTHON_DIR}/gnuradio/glidelink)

# the user modules' reference models and descriptions (hw/modules), used by modules.py
set(HW_MODULES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../hw/modules)
install(FILES ${HW_MODULES}/sc16.py DESTINATION ${GR_PYTHON_DIR}/gnuradio/glidelink/modules)
foreach(m nco fir)
    install(FILES ${HW_MODULES}/${m}/model.py ${HW_MODULES}/${m}/module.yaml
            DESTINATION ${GR_PYTHON_DIR}/gnuradio/glidelink/modules/${m})
endforeach()

########################################################################
# Handle the unit tests
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

set(GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-glidelink)

# Create a package directory that tests can import. It includes everything
# from `python/`.
add_custom_target(
    copy_module_for_tests ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/test_modules/gnuradio/glidelink/)
